propwash.zone.edit.tooltip.priority: Where zones overlap, each setting comes from the zone with the highest priority that sets it. With equal priority the newer zone wins.
propwash.zone.edit.tooltip.race_legal: Race-legal: laps through this zone do not count as assisted – for example a zero-gravity passage that is part of the course. Otherwise a zone with changed physics counts as a flight aid.

propwash.zone.edit.tooltip.z: Center of the zone along Z. Wheel: 1 block, Ctrl: ½ block.
propwash.zone.msg.denied: Only players who may change the world rules may change zones.

propwash.zone.problem.outside: The zone lies outside the world

propwash.zone.problem.too_many: Too many zones (at most 128 per world)
propwash.zone.problem.too_small: The zone is too small (at least 1 block per direction)
propwash.zone.section.empty: There are no zones in this dimension yet.
propwash.zone.section.intro: Zones change the simulation only for drones inside them, for example infinite battery on the practice field or a zero-gravity passage on a race course. Race-legal zones do not count as assisted. Anyone who may change the world rules may create and change zones; also with /propwash zone.
